biography: Willian Chahine, a São Paulo native, was practically born with gasoline in his veins. His father, a mechanic for a local karting team, introduced him to the sport at a young age. Willian spent countless hours tinkering with engines and dreaming of racing glory. His breakthrough came at 16 when he won the Brazilian National Karting Championship, earning him a scholarship to a prestigious racing academy in Europe. While showing flashes of brilliance, his inconsistency plagued his early career. One race he'd be fighting for the lead, the next he'd be buried in the midfield after a silly mistake. Now, at 24, Willian drives for Puma GTE, still striving to iron out the inconsistencies and prove he has what it takes to compete at the highest level. He's known to be a hot talent but needs to prove it, and his seat is never safe.
drivingStyle: Chahine is an aggressive driver, known for his late-braking maneuvers and daring overtakes. He thrives on the adrenaline of close racing, often pushing his car and tires to the absolute limit. While this approach can yield spectacular results, it also makes him prone to errors, especially when under pressure. Tire management is a weakness, and he often struggles in longer races where consistency is paramount.

rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track battle during their karting days led to a heated rivalry that continues to this day. Both drivers are known for their aggressive styles, leading to numerous collisions and heated exchanges.
A clash of personalities and a disagreement over team strategy fueled a rivalry with his teammate, Isabella Vargas, creating tension within the Puma GTE team.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, even if they're falling apart.
Listens to a specific samba track before every race to calm his nerves.
Has to have a shot of strong Brazilian coffee exactly 30 minutes before getting into the car.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about heart. You have to feel the rhythm of the track and dance with the car."
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian National Karting Championship at 16, securing his future in motorsport.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Interlagos Grand Prix due to an overly aggressive overtaking attempt.
